rovers.name: Lunar Roving Vehicle (Apollo 15-17)

description.pt: 1971-72, dois astronautas, rodas de tela de aço de 81,8 cm

rovers.source_reference: NSSDC: 210 kg, 3.10 m, two 36 V 121 Ah silver-zinc batteries, not rechargeable. Mean draw estimated. Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: VIPER (NASA)

description.en: South pole ice hunter, 1 m drill, three upright solar panels
description.pt: Caçador de gelo do polo sul, broca de 1 m, três painéis solares em pé

rovers.source_reference: NASA NTRS (LSIC 2024): battery 5,420 Wh, panels 320-450 W; 57 h on battery alone in test, so about 95 W. Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Lunar Terrain Vehicle (Artemis)

description.en: In development, two astronauts, design not frozen
description.pt: Em desenvolvimento, dois astronautas, desenho ainda não congelado

rovers.source_reference: NASA has not published mass or size; class estimates (about 500 kg). Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Lunar Outpost MAPP

description.en: Compact commercial rover, side solar wall and camera tower
description.pt: Rover comercial compacto, parede solar lateral e torre de câmeras

rovers.source_reference: Illustrative values: the maker has not published a full data sheet. Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Sojourner (Mars Pathfinder)

description.en: What if it went to the Moon? 10.6 kg, six 13 cm wheels
description.pt: E se fosse à Lua? 10,6 kg, seis rodas de 13 cm

rovers.source_reference: NASA: 10.6 kg, 30 cm tall, 0.22 m² panel giving about 16 W; non-rechargeable Li-SOCl2 battery (capacity estimated). Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Mars Exploration Rover (Spirit / Opportunity)

description.en: What if it went to the Moon?

rovers.source_reference: Panels about 140 W, about 100 W to drive; two 8 Ah Li-ion batteries (energy estimated). Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Curiosity (Mars Science Laboratory)

description.en: What if it went to the Moon? Nuclear (MMRTG), 899 kg
description.pt: E se fosse à Lua? Nuclear (MMRTG), 899 kg

rovers.source_reference: science.nasa.gov: 899 kg, 3.0 x 2.7 x 2.2 m; MMRTG about 110 W; two 42 Ah Li-ion batteries (energy estimated). Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.

rovers.name: Perseverance (Mars 2020)

description.en: What if it went to the Moon?

rovers.source_reference: NSSDC: about 1,025 kg, 3.0 x 2.7 x 2.2 m; MMRTG about 110 W; two 43 Ah Li-ion batteries (energy estimated). Our group's rover catalogue, commit 2195fcb.
